page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7nex.8xlarge is a compute-optimized instance powered by an Intel Xeon 8369B processor with an x86_64 architecture. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs mapped to 16 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled, running at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The instance is configured with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a 2.0 GB per core ratio. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage and featuring a baseline network bandwidth of 40 Gbps.

Performance benchmarks place this instance in the average tier across all tested categories. The CPU achieves a stress-ng single-core score of 1854.09 and a multi-core score of 31066.87, supported by AVX-512 vector extensions and cryptographic acceleration flags like AES and SHA_NI. Memory bandwidth tests show a cached read speed of 1675.96 GB/sec and an uncached large block write speed of 67.93 GB/sec. In application-level benchmarks, the instance demonstrates throughput with 31.02 million Redis SET operations per second and 32.08 GB/sec in static web serving.

The 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio represents a clear tradeoff, optimizing the instance for compute-heavy tasks while limiting its suitability for memory-bound databases or large-scale data caching. The lack of local NVMe storage requires reliance on network storage, which may introduce latency for I/O-heavy operations. However, the dedicated CPU allocation and 40 Gbps network bandwidth provide predictable performance. This profile is cost-efficient for high-density compute workloads, such as software compilation, web serving, and multi-threaded decompression tasks, where CPU utilization is high but memory requirements remain moderate.
